note: Corrections applied on top of the GTFS feed by scripts/generate_gtfs_geojson.cjs. Empty is the healthy state: it means the feed describes the network as it actually runs. Add entries here only for something the feed gets wrong, and always with a source and a date, so the next person can tell a real correction from a stale workaround.

history.was: Aragó, Amistat and Ayora added by hand, plus lines 5 and 7 tagged onto Marítim
history.why: The 2026-07-28 feed had no line 5 or 7 service east of Alameda and its service calendar had already expired on 2026-08-30. The live arrivals API was returning line 5 trains bound for Marítim, so the feed was stale rather than the network being out of service. The 2026-09-02 feed carries all three stations as real stops (Aragó 120, Amistat 121, Ayora 122) and the eastern routes, so the overlay is no longer needed.
